title: The Domain of the Mind
coreMove: A calm mind is not empty; it is guarded enough to see the hinge, name the noise, and keep action tied to the point that matters when pressure gets loud.

exampleSpecs.domain: city logistics desk during a morning alert spike
exampleSpecs.audience: operators who start the day by obeying every alert
exampleSpecs.stakes: A routine built for speed is pulling attention away from the one route that matters.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: The protagonist stops an alert-clearing routine and restarts from the hinge question.

exampleSpecs.domain: state policy office before a budget hearing
exampleSpecs.audience: staffers who confuse visible motion with progress
exampleSpecs.stakes: A small detail shows how steady aim can matter more than more activity.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A close observed moment lets the source case teach without a live decision.

exampleSpecs.domain: software launch review after a missed deadline
exampleSpecs.audience: teams reviewing a failure after chasing visible fires
exampleSpecs.stakes: The review can blame effort levels or find the missed hinge.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Open after the failure and locate the one misstep that scattered attention.

exampleSpecs.domain: quarterly planning meeting with too many priorities
exampleSpecs.audience: team leads who notice their own scattered attention while speaking
exampleSpecs.stakes: The meeting can keep rewarding volume or return to the strategic key.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: The protagonist notices her own error mid-stream and corrects the frame.

exampleSpecs.domain: nonprofit fundraising team choosing a campaign focus
exampleSpecs.audience: leaders who need a written artifact to protect attention
exampleSpecs.stakes: A scattered campaign will look active while missing the lever that funds the year.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: The memo carries the action and shows the source case inside its written logic.

exampleSpecs.domain: hospital bed-control desk during a discharge delay
exampleSpecs.audience: operators comparing frantic response with commanded attention
exampleSpecs.stakes: Two approaches to the same pressure will either scatter the desk or release capacity.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Two named people face the same situation with opposite approaches and diverging outcomes.
